verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS compliance platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows one. The public OpenAPI spec, OAuth client credentials, and llms.txt are developer building blocks and adjacent AI-readiness signals. They are not an official MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
